question: Which of the following was the guest nation at the Hyderabad Literary Festival 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Kingdom**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The guest nation at the **Hyderabad Literary Festival 2022** was the **United Kingdom**.
 
• The festival is an annual event that celebrates literature, arts, and culture, attracting participants and speakers from around the world.
 
• The presence of the United Kingdom as the guest nation highlights the cultural and literary ties between India and the UK.
 
• The event featured various sessions, workshops, and performances showcasing the literary and cultural heritage of the United Kingdom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Hyderabad Literary Festival (HLF)** is held annually in Hyderabad, India, and is a major cultural event in the region.
 
• The festival features a diverse range of activities including panel discussions, readings, workshops, cultural performances, and art exhibitions.
 
• HLF aims to promote literature and the arts, providing a platform for writers, artists, and intellectuals to engage with the public and with each other.
 
• Each year, the festival invites a guest nation to showcase its literary and cultural contributions.
 
• The festival also includes sessions in multiple languages, reflecting the linguistic diversity of India.
